capture_source: live capture 2026-11-08: NW RFC SDK client (pyrfc 3.3) calling RFC_READ_TABLE with a 900-row OPTIONS table of random text against an S/4HANA gateway (kernel 793), plain RFC. The call succeeded.
evidence: tier 1. The client's request frames, each with its 4-byte NI length prefix: two 0x0608 frames (28000 and 376 payload bytes) and an 80-byte 0x0609 frame. Joined, the payloads form the request's complete TLV stream (no 8-byte footer).
notes: A request whose TLV stream fits in 28000 bytes travels as one 0x06CB frame with the footer instead.
Header differences to 0x06CB: [0:2] type, [24:32] zero, [48:52] payload length; the 0x0609 frame has [28:32] = 00 00 01 00 and [48:52] = 28000.
